title: The wings on this Airbus flex way more than they should
summary: A one-minute clip from Insider showing an Airbus airliner's wings flexing far more than most people expect during a wing load test. It is meant to reassure nervous flyers about turbulence.
why: HN commenters link it to show how much stress airliner wings are designed to withstand, especially in turbulence and crash threads.

quote.text: see how much airplane wings can bend without breaking
